source_row.rationale: LMWH generally has more predictable pharmacokinetics compared to unfractionated heparin, so routine PTT monitoring is generally not required for most clients (though anti-Xa monitoring may be used in certain situations, such as renal impairment or pregnancy), and it is typically administered via subcutaneous injection rather than continuous IV infusion.
source_row.source_detail: Prescribing information/monitoring: routine coagulation tests such as aPTT are not suitable for monitoring LMWH effect; current label updated 2026, accessed 2026-08-14.
